## **Bugs und Stabilität** {#theme-bugs_stability}

<!--ir-theme:bugs_stability-->
   **Bugs und Stabilität.**
      6 aktuelle Review(s) erwähnen bugs und stabilität.
      Review-Fenster: 02.08.2026 - 19.09.2026
      **Warum das zählt:** Nutzer erwähnen Crashes oder Instabilität. Nur bei Volume-Spike oder nach einem Update als actionable werten; sonst oft Baseline-Rauschen.

         **Review-Beispiele:**
            1. _Cesar Augusto Alanoca Lima (tictac)_, 18.09.2026, 1/5: "Completely unusable — Blocked after just 2 days and 26 MB of use Review: ​I paid for an annual Starter plan and the app became completely useless within 48 hours. After using just 26 MB of data, saving basic links and a few images triggered a hidden attachment cap. Now I'm permanently stuck on a "limit reached" lock screen and cannot create, write, or edit notes unless I upgrade again. Paying for a full year to have an unusable app at 26 MB is unacceptable. Completely misleading."
            2. _Richard Castro_, 17.09.2026, 1/5: "Terrible money grabbing app . Absolutely unusable unless you pay for it. Skip this app completely!"
            3. _Abhishek Chauhan_, 19.09.2026, 2/5: "This was the best app for me since last 10 year. It pains me to give it 2 stars because the greed of the company has made this app unusable for free users. I was a paying user since last 4 or so years but I can't support greed of a corporation so I am stopping using this app now and moving all my notes to other app."
<!--/ir-theme-->
